instruction: I have invited some of my friends to a reunion party via phone messages. I have made a CSV to track who is coming or not in "~/documents/personal_stuff/" in my file system. Please update RSVPs in it as per their latest replies.
notes: Apps: supervisor, file_system, phone. The CSV is discovered via show_directory on ~/documents/personal_stuff/, read via show_file (which reveals the invitees and their phone numbers), then for each invitee the latest text reply is fetched with phone.search_text_messages filtered by phone_number; finally the whole CSV is rewritten once with update_file so exactly one file record changes and the header stays intact. The number of invitees is unknown a priori; the model assumes 3 (consistent with the 10-call reference solution) and uses a discrete counter (c0..c3 with succ) so that update_file is only allowed after every invitee's reply has been retrieved, avoiding quantified preconditions. If the CSV lists names without phone numbers, the phone numbers would instead be obtained via phone.search_contacts before the message searches. rsvps-updated is nullary because the only file of interest is the RSVP CSV (guarded by rsvp-csv), letting supervisor-complete-task state the goal condition directly.
